CRM_PIPELINES.DESCRIPTION: Organize your sales process in pipelines. Every pipeline starts with the New contact stage and ends with Won and Lost.
CRM_PIPELINES.EMPTY: No pipelines yet. Create the first one to start organizing your sales.
CRM_PIPELINES.DELETE_DEFAULT_BLOCKED: The default pipeline cannot be deleted. Set another pipeline as the default first.

AUTO_CREATE.TITLE: Create deals automatically
AUTO_CREATE.DESCRIPTION: When a conversation is assigned to an agent, a deal is created in the default pipeline, in the New contact stage, for contacts without an open deal. The agent becomes the owner. Requires a default pipeline.

FORM.CREATE_DESCRIPTION: The New contact, Won and Lost stages are added automatically.

DELETE_CONFIRM.MESSAGE: Are you sure you want to delete the pipeline {name}? Its stages are deleted too.
